title: The Hamiltonian Normal Form
summary: An important step in the proof of the Herman invariant tori conjecture was the introduction of a normal form with poles along the resonance loci, replacing the Birkhoff normal form, which we call the Hamiltonian normal form. This paper is extracted from previous versions (arXiv:1206.1245, arXiv:1909.06053) and aims to present this Hamiltonian normal form in its simplest form. It is expected that, not only theoretically but also in numerical computations, it will provide better approximations than the standard Birkhoff normal form.
